tailoring.lace_applique.description: Lace applique technique - motifs applied to surface
tailoring.lace_applique.contents: Individual lace motifs on bodice and skirt surfaces.

tailoring.lace_insertion.description: Lace insertion bands - inset between fabric sections
tailoring.lace_insertion.contents: Narrow lace bands (8-15mm) inserted between fabric sections as decorative divider lines.

tailoring.chantilly_overlay.description: Chantilly lace overlay - delicate all-over pattern
tailoring.chantilly_overlay.contents: Delicate floral lace across bodice or skirt as overlay. Fine bobbin lace with scrolling pattern.

tailoring.guipure_motifs.contents: Heavy raised lace with bold floral or geometric motifs connected by thread bridges. Dense sculptural texture.

tailoring.eyelet_embroidery.description: Eyelet embroidery - punched and stitched holes
tailoring.eyelet_embroidery.contents: Small holes with dense satin stitch borders.

tailoring.smocking_geometric.contents: Gathered in controlled grid pattern - honeycomb or diamond texture.

tailoring.pintucks_precision.contents: Very narrow parallel folds (1-3mm width) creating raised linear texture.

tailoring.fagoting_openwork.contents: Two edges held apart with decorative hand stitching creating openwork band.

tailoring.drawn_thread.description: Drawn thread work - pulled fabric creating voids
tailoring.drawn_thread.contents: Horizontal or vertical threads removed creating linear voids. Remaining threads bundled with stitching.

tailoring.french_seams.contents: Seam allowances completely enclosed. Clean finished interior.

tailoring.bound_buttonholes.contents: Opening edges bound with narrow strips creating rectangular window.

tailoring.hong_kong_finish.description: Hong Kong seam finish - bias-bound raw edges
tailoring.hong_kong_finish.contents: Interior seam allowances bound with narrow bias tape.

tailoring.hand_rolled_edges.contents: Edge rolled extremely fine (1-2mm) with invisible stitching. Delicate finished edge on sheer fabrics.

tailoring.cording_piping.contents: Cord encased in bias tape as raised trim.

tailoring.gathered_lace_ruffle.contents: Lace strip gathered densely and as trim.

tailoring.venice_lace_motifs.description: Venice lace - heavy raised needle lace
tailoring.venice_lace_motifs.contents: Heavy raised needle lace with sculptural floral motifs.

tailoring.cut_work_embroidery.description: Cutwork embroidery - fabric removed creating voids
tailoring.cut_work_embroidery.contents: Areas cut away with dense stitching reinforcing edges creating voids.
